questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

(16, 4, 4)

(30, 5, 15)

(8, 2, ?)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**First Number - (3 × Second Number) = Third Number**

So

16 - (3 × 4) = 4

and 

30 - (3 × 5) = 15

Similarly,

8 - (3 × 2) = 2

Hence, the correct answer is** "2".**

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All rice are wheat.

Some wheats are pulses.

No pulse is a vegetable.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some vegetables are rice.

II. Some pulses are rice.

III. Some vegetables are wheat.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0e873560a80331648f337d93c556e4ed2c750c9ef36e803df02629b987926f3.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some vegetables are rice → **False** (As All rice are wheat and Some wheats are pulses and No pulse is a vegetable so, Some vegetables are rice is possible but not definitely true.)

II. Some pulses are rice → **False** (As All rice are wheat and Some wheats are pulses so, Some pulses are rice is possible but not definitely true.)

III. Some vegetables are wheat → **False** (As Some wheats are pulses and No pulse is a vegetable so, Some vegetables are wheat is false)

Hence, the correct answer is **"****None of the conclusions follow".**

questions.question:
Which of the following interchange of numbers and signs would make the given equation correct?

512 × 64 ÷ 5 + 30 - 50 = 20
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 50 and 64, + and ×

Given equation is : 512 × 64 ÷ 5 + 30 - 50 = 20

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 512 + 50 ÷ 5 × 30 - 64 = 20

⇒ 512 + __**50 ÷ 5**__ × 30 - 64 = 20

⇒ 512 + __**10 × 30**__ - 64 = 20

⇒ __**512 + 300**__ - 64 = 20

⇒ __**812 - 64**__ = 20

⇒ 748 ≠ 20

Option 2) : 20 and 30, + and ÷ 

Given equation is : 512 × 64 ÷ 5 + 30 - 50 = 20

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 512 × 64 + 5 ÷ 20 - 50 = 30

⇒ 512 × 64 + __**5 ÷ 20**__ - 50 = 30

⇒ __**512 × 64**__ + 0.25 - 50 = 30

⇒ __**32768 + 0.25**__ - 50 = 30

⇒ __**32768.25 - 50**__ = 30

⇒ 32718.25 ≠ 30

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 20 and 50, × and ÷ 

Given equation is : 512 × 64 ÷ 5 + 30 - 50 = 20

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 512 ÷ 64 × 5 + 30 - 20 = 50

⇒ __**512 ÷ 64**__ × 5 + 30 - 20 = 50

⇒ __**8 × 5**__ + 30 - 20 = 50

⇒ __**40 + 30**__ - 20 = 50

⇒ __**70 - 20**__ = 50

⇒ **50 = 50**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : 5 and 20, + and -

Given equation is : 512 × 64 ÷ 5 + 30 - 50 = 20

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 512 × 64 ÷ 20 - 30 + 50 = 5

⇒ 512 × __**64 ÷ 20**__ - 30 + 50 = 5

⇒ __**512 × 3.2**__ - 30 + 50 = 5

⇒ __**1638.4**__ - 30 __**+ 50**__ = 5

⇒ __**1688.4 - 30**__ = 5

⇒ 1658.4 ≠ 5

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"20 and 50, × and ÷ ".**
